title: PieArena: Ranking and Profiling Language Agents in Realistic Negotiation Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2602.05302v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present an in-depth evaluation of LLMs' ability to negotiate, a central business task that requires strategic reasoning and theory of mind to create and claim economic value. To do so, we introduce PieArena, a large-scale negotiation benchmark grounded in multi-agent interactions over realistic scenarios adapted from MBA negotiation courses at an elite business school. We evaluate language agents across three pairing regimes: mirror-play, cross-play, and human-LM play. We develop a ranking model for continuous negotiation payoffs that yields order-invariant, uncertainty-quantified leaderboards while correcting for systematic experimental asymmetries. translated_title: PieArena：在现实谈判场景中对语言智能体进行排名与画像
translated_abstract: 我们对大语言模型的谈判能力进行了深入评估。谈判是一项核心商业任务，需要策略性推理和心智理论来创造并获取经济价值。为此，我们推出了 PieArena——一个大规模谈判基准，其场景改编自一所顶尖商学院的 MBA 谈判课程中的现实案例，并在多智能体交互中展开。我们在三种配对模式下评估语言智能体：镜像对局、交叉对局和人机对局。我们开发了一个针对连续谈判收益的排名模型，可在校正系统性实验不对称性的同时，生成顺序不变且具有不确定性量化的排行榜。我们进一步研究了共享意图性智能体支架的效果，发现其收益是不对称的：中低档语言模型获得大幅提升，而前沿模型则收益递减。作为校准锚点，我们从受过训练的谈判参与者中收集了人与人以及人与模型的谈判数据。
tldr: 提出 PieArena——基于真实 MBA 谈判场景的大规模多智能体谈判基准，通过顺序不变、不确定性量化的排名模型在三种配对模式下评估语言智能体，并发现共享意图性支架对中低档模型收益显著而对前沿模型收益递减。
en_tdlr: PieArena is a large-scale negotiation benchmark grounded in realistic MBA-course scenarios that ranks language agents across mirror-play, cross-play, and human-LM regimes using an order-invariant, uncertainty-quantified ranking model, revealing that shared-intentionality scaffolding yields large gains for mid- and lower-tier LMs but diminishing returns for frontier models.
